psalm-43-1.verse: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man!
psalm-43-1.prayer: Lord, defend my cause and help me trust in Your justice. When I face unfair situations, remind me that You are my righteous Judge.

psalm-43-2.verse: For You are the God of my strength; why have You rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
psalm-43-2.prayer: Father, You are my strength and refuge. When I feel rejected, discouraged, or confused, help me remain secure in Your love.

psalm-43-3.verse: O send out Your light and Your truth, let them lead me; Let them bring me to Your holy hill And to Your dwelling places.
psalm-43-3.prayer: Lord, send out Your light and Your truth to guide me. Lead me closer to Your presence and direct my steps according to Your will.

psalm-43-4.verse: Then I will go to the altar of God, To God my exceeding joy; And upon the lyre I shall praise You, O God, my God.
psalm-43-4.prayer: Father, bring me into deeper fellowship with You. Let my heart find joy, peace, and satisfaction in Your presence.

psalm-43-5.verse: Why are you in despair, O my soul? And why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God, for I shall again praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.
psalm-43-5.prayer: Lord, when my soul is discouraged, help me place my hope in You. Remind me that You are my Savior, my help, and my God.

psalm-43-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for being my strength, my guide, and my source of hope. When I face uncertainty or discouragement, help me trust in Your truth and follow Your light. Draw me closer to Your presence and fill my heart with joy that comes from knowing You. May I continually place my hope in You and praise You as my Savior and my God.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
